arguments.content:
from rich.console import Console

def test_record_and_capture():
    console = Console(record=True)
    with console.capture() as capture:
        console.print("Hello")
        console.print("World")
    
    captured = capture.get()
    print(f"Captured: {repr(captured)}")
    
    recorded = console.export_text()
    print(f"Recorded: {repr(recorded)}")
    
    assert "Hello" in captured
    assert "World" in captured
    assert "Hello" in recorded
    assert "World" in recorded

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_record_and_capture()
